Just three blocks from the beach and West of I-5, this light and bright home offers beautiful ocean views, solar-powered energy, and a versatile layout. The open-concept living and kitchen area features large windows framing ocean views, luxury vinyl plank flooring, recessed lighting, and abundant natural light. The contemporary kitchen features quartz countertops, GE Café stainless steel appliances, white cabinetry, and a spacious peninsula island.  The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and beautifully appointed bath with modern finishes. The flexible bonus room adds valuable living space and can easily serve as an office, workout space, or den. Additional features include central A/C & heat, in-unit full-size stackable washer & dryer, custom window treatments, and excellent sound insulation.  North Swell offers secure building access, elevator service, solar-powered energy, two assigned parking spaces in the garage, and a dedicated storage locker. The spectacular rooftop terrace is a true standout, offering expansive panoramic ocean views, plenty of seating, and the perfect setting for entertaining, enjoying the coastal breeze, or watching beautiful Oceanside sunsets. Just minutes from the beach, Oceanside Pier, restaurants, and trails.

results.remarks: Bright, breezy and beautifully positioned, this corner residence at The Heights at Bay Park captures the ease of San Diego coastal living. Natural light pours in from multiple exposures, while the corner balcony creates an inviting outdoor retreat for morning coffee, evening unwinding and enjoying the fresh coastal air. The thoughtfully positioned kitchen sits just off the main living space with its own window, bringing in sunlight and coastal breezes while keeping the home feeling open, comfortable and connected. Light finishes and an easy-flowing layout add to the relaxed, airy feel from the moment you walk in.  Set in the heart of San Diego, this Bay Park location puts you close to everything people love about the city. Downtown San Diego, Mission Bay, the beaches, dining, shopping and neighborhood favorites are all just minutes away—and you can reach the bay and coast without ever getting on the freeway. Spend the morning by the water, meet friends downtown, enjoy an afternoon along the bay, then come home to your own bright corner retreat.  It is a rare combination of central location, coastal access and easy everyday living, with the freedom to enjoy more of San Diego and spend less time getting there. Perfect for anyone looking for a low-maintenance lifestyle without giving up light, outdoor space or location. Simple living. Elevated living. Coastal living. A fresh, light-filled corner home designed for the way San Diego is meant to be lived.

results.remarks: Photographs only tell part of the story. The true scale and depth of these panoramic views are impossible to appreciate until experienced in person.  Located in Cortez Blu, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence in Downtown San Diego's Cortez Hill neighborhood offers 1,217 square feet with some of the finest panoramic views in Downtown San Diego. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame a sweeping 180-degree panorama from the Coronado Bridge and Coronado Islands across the downtown skyline and San Diego Bay to the Pacific Ocean and sunsets over Point Loma. To the north, Balboa Park unfolds beneath the skyline, anchored by the iconic blue-and-gold tiled California Tower.  Inside, new luxury vinyl plank flooring, exposed architectural concrete walls and ceilings, a neutral interior ready for your personal vision, and a brand-new, never-used oven/range and microwave create a refined industrial aesthetic with room to make it your own. A spacious balcony off the living room and a private balcony off the primary suite offer two outdoor spaces to enjoy the views.  Cortez Hill is known for its peaceful residential character and commanding views over Downtown San Diego, offering a unique balance of tranquility and urban convenience.  Residences with views this expansive, this much living space, and this level of value seldom come to market. Thoughtfully priced, this home delivers a luxury lifestyle without the luxury price tag—making it one of Downtown San Diego's most compelling values.

results.remarks: Claim your place at the iconic Harbor Club. Freshly painted throughout and fitted with brand-new hard surface flooring, this southwest-facing residence offers a clean, contemporary canvas with stunning views of the San Diego Convention Center, Downtown skyline, and glimpses of the harbor beyond. A built-in window seat in the living area creates the perfect spot to take in the cityscape, while the private balcony invites you to soak up those trademark Pacific Ocean breezes, golden afternoon light, and front-row views of the blue water. Signature arched passageways add architectural character throughout, lending a timeless Mediterranean touch to the bright, airy floor plan. The well-appointed kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, stainless appliances, a sleek cooktop with wall oven, and under-cabinet lighting: all framed by a graceful archway that opens to the main living space. The spacious primary suite offers generous closet space, brand new carpet, and a spa-inspired ensuite bath complete with dual vanities, a deep soaking tub, and a separate frameless glass shower, all finished in warm travertine. Additional highlights include floor-to-ceiling windows, mirrored accent walls that amplify the light and views, and two assigned parking spaces. Whether you're seeking a polished pied-à-terre or your full-time Downtown sanctuary, this turnkey residence captures the very best of Marina District living.  Residents of the Harbor Club are treated to an array of lavish, resort-inspired amenities that encompass a round-the-clock front desk service, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, an exquisite pool deck, a sociable club room, and a versatile library/business center, among numerous other perks. Nestled in the much-coveted Marina District, the Harbor Club boasts unparalleled ease in traversing the neighborhood on foot, granting effortless access to an array of transportation options, delectable dining establishments, retail therapy, the iconic ballpark, the pulsating Gaslamp Quarter, the artsy East Village, and the scenic Embarcadero – an idyllic setting for serene walks alongside the bay.

results.remarks: Imagine coming home to one of San Diego’s most vibrant neighborhoods — where every day feels like a getaway. This residence places you right in the heart of downtown, just steps from world-class restaurants, trendy cafés, boutique shops, and the famed Little Italy Farmers Market, held twice weekly on Wednesdays and Saturdays.  Step inside and you’ll immediately notice how this thoughtfully designed home captures both comfort and urban flair. At the end of the day, step out onto your oversized private balcony — a rare outdoor retreat where you can sip your morning coffee while the city comes alive or unwind as the sun sets over the skyline and city lights begin to twinkle. From this exceptional vantage point, enjoy SeaWorld fireworks throughout the summer, spectacular Fourth of July fireworks displays across the city, and iconic San Diego skyline views. Whether hosting friends or enjoying a quiet moment alone, this outdoor space expands your living area and frames a lifestyle that is quintessentially San Diego.  Inside, the space flows with light and character, offering a seamless blend of comfort and cosmopolitan energy. A rare advantage of this residence is that there are no neighbors directly below, providing an added sense of privacy and tranquility. You'll also appreciate the convenience of a private storage unit located on the same level as the home, making everyday access effortless. And when it’s time to go out — or come home — you’ll love having two dedicated parking spaces, a true luxury in this bustling downtown setting.  Living here means some of San Diego’s most beloved destinations are just moments away. Enjoy a 5-minute walk to the Little Italy Farmers Market, the Maritime Museum, and Santa Fe Depot, providing easy access to Amtrak, Coaster, and Trolley service. Catch a concert at The Rady Shell, just a scenic 1.5-mile waterfront stroll away, or walk to Civic Theatre and Symphony Towers in minutes. Padres games at Petco Park are only a short trolley ride away, while the USS Midway Museum, waterfront promenade, ferry service to Coronado, Balboa Park, and San Diego International Airport are all conveniently nearby.  It’s not just a place to live — it’s a lifestyle where every sunset invites a waterfront stroll, every weekend offers a new adventure, and the very best of San Diego is right outside your door.

results.remarks: Experience luxury living at CityFront Terrace, one of Downtown San Diego’s most distinguished high-rise communities in the heart of the Marina District. Perfectly situated just moments from the waterfront, Seaport Village, The New Children’s Museum, Petco Park, and some of the city’s finest restaurants and entertainment.  This residence places you in the center of everything San Diego has to offer.  This is an exceptional opportunity to own one of the building’s limited one-bedroom residences. Filled with natural light, the home offers an inviting layout, timeless finishes, and an oversized covered balcony that extends your living space outdoors. Enjoy views toward Petco Park, creating the perfect setting to catch the energy of game days from the comfort of home. From the balcony, you have an east facing view for sunrise mornings overlooking the Coranado Bridge.   Included with the residence is a dedicated valet parking space, offering unmatched convenience in one of Downtown’s most desirable neighborhoods.  CityFront Terrace is renowned for its resort-inspired amenities and impeccable grounds. The community seamlessly blends modern luxury with San Diego history, incorporating the preserved facade of the historic Citrus Soap Factory and stunning gardens known as the “Urban Canyon,” complete with mature landscaping and a spectacular 90-foot waterfall.  Residents enjoy an impressive collection of amenities, including two heated swimming pools, a spa, outdoor barbecue and entertaining areas, a fire pit, and beautifully landscaped gathering spaces.   The expansive fitness center features strength and cardio equipment, a yoga room, locker rooms, showers, and saunas. While the resident lounge, entertainment room with full kitchen, business center, conference room, and complimentary Wi-Fi provide exceptional convenience for both work and leisure. Additional features include assigned storage, bicycle rooms, EV charging capability, secure package handling, and a 24-hour attended lobby with concierge service.  Whether you’re searching for a full-time residence, a sophisticated second home, or a lock-and-leave downtown retreat, CityFront Terrace delivers an unmatched lifestyle in one of San Diego’s premier luxury communities.  Rarely available and highly sought after, this one-bedroom residence is an opportunity you won’t want to miss.
